citation: Stopfer et al., PNAS 2021, Absolute quantification of tumor antigens using embedded MHC-I isotopologue calibrants
panel_selection_note: 18 selected tumor-antigen sequences chosen as predicted HLA-A*02:01 binders; S1 affinities are predictions, not experimental binding labels, and do not establish measured allele restriction for every source sample.

free_1h_direct_spike.uncertainty_note: Retain vendor/author AAA assignment and purity report; not independently certified.

embedded_2h_hipmhc_pre_ip.uncertainty_note: Reflects reported post-exchange ELISA complex concentration plus IP capture/recovery; not independently certified.

observation_roles.nominal_standard_amount_fmol: Nominal spike amount reported in fmol (free 1H peptide or embedded 2H hipMHC).
observation_roles.free_1h_direct_spike_summed_signal: Targeted SureQuant/IS-PRM summed fragment-ion area for free 1H peptide spiked into pre-purified HLA-peptide matrix (S3A).
observation_roles.embedded_2h_hipmhc_pre_ip_summed_signal: Targeted SureQuant/IS-PRM summed fragment-ion area for embedded 2H hipMHC spiked before immunoprecipitation (S3B).
observation_roles.selected_transition_count: Count of selected product-ion transitions detected at each hipMHC dose (S3C); NOT signal intensity or molecule amount.
observation_roles.predicted_affinity_nm: Computational NetMHCpan predicted HLA-A*02:01 affinity in nM (S1); NOT experimental binding.
observation_roles.analytical_4h_trigger_reagent: Heavy 4H isotopologue SureQuant analytical trigger reagent; NOT biological machinery or endogenous ligand.
observation_roles.inferred_endogenous_abundance: Inferred endogenous copies/cell (separate from known-dose raw-response calibration).

pride_hipmhc_spikein.filename_spelling_note: Dataset S7 row 59 spells this filename with a double 'i' (Iso18_hipMHCspiikein_TransitionResults.xlsx); the actual PRIDE PXD024917 deposit filename uses a single 'i' (Iso18_hipMHCspikein_TransitionResults.xlsx).

known_source_conflicts.summary: Dataset S3A/S3B label summed-signal columns only as C/D/E without acquisition names. PRIDE Iso18_hipMHCspikein_TransitionResults.xlsx proves replicate 100fmol_2 is absent while 100fmol_3 was shifted into S3B column D leaving all 9 column E cells blank at 100 fmol. Column-to-acquisition links must be numerically verified against transition exports, never assumed as C=run1/D=run2/E=run3.

Dataset S6A A10:C10 reports V / 13C3, 15N1 / 4.007 Da, whereas Dataset S3 uses V[+6] and Dataset S6B nominal mass shifts match +6 Da (13C5, 15N1). Arithmetic audit across 72 S6B isotopologue records flags 54 inconsistent with summing S6A masses (single shared Valine table inconsistency, not 54 independent chemical failures). Both assertions are preserved without rewriting.

Dataset S6B B99/E99 specifies labeled Methionine (M: 13C5, 15N1) in 4H (A)M(L)GTHT(M)E(V), but Dataset S6A contains no Methionine row. Marked uncheckable_from_s6a rather than claiming Methionine labeling is absent from the source.
Dataset S7 row 59 lists Iso18_hipMHCspiikein_TransitionResults.xlsx while PRIDE PXD024917 deposits Iso18_hipMHCspikein_TransitionResults.xlsx.
